representation.drug: Morgan radius-2 2048-bit feature store; optional gated molecular PLM residual (BERMOL768 smoke-validated, not promoted)
representation.target: ProtBERT 1024 exact-sequence feature store; optional pooled ESM2 auxiliary and residue-level ESM2 token cross-attention
representation.structure: optional pair-aligned pocket/structure vector with explicit structure_mask; safe 19-d target-context store available for 61450/86674 pairs
representation.conplex: optional frozen external score, separately auditable

architecture.drug_auxiliary_encoder: optional molecular PL residual 768 -> 512 -> 192 with pair-conditioned gated residual
architecture.target_auxiliary_encoder: optional ESM2-650M pooled 1280 -> 512 -> 192 residual gated branch
architecture.target_token_encoder: optional stitched ESM2 residue tokens -> 192 with drug-conditioned multi-head cross-attention
architecture.routing: drug_embedding + target_embedding + family_embedding -> pair-conditioned softmax expert gate
architecture.structure_residual: drug/target/structure cross features -> residual trunk -> gated residual logit
heads: expert gate and structure gate diagnostics

fallback_invariant: structure_mask=0 implies final_logit == base_logit exactly; missing structure is never encoded as negative interaction

training_defaults.minibatch_sampler: target_aware_chunks_default; optional linear dual_query target/drug chunks; random opt-out
training_defaults.validation_selection: 0.50 micro AUPRC + 0.30 target-macro AUPRC + 0.20 drug-macro AUPRC
